purpose: The copy of what an app has read, kept in the browser per person and workspace as a starting point and never an answer, bounded by size, and gone when the person goes.
namedChanges: the first comment line loses its cycle tag, the app's name and a person's name, and the seventh no longer names the source app's bridge file; no code changed;

the type-only import of `ListedRecord`, `RecordDoc`, `ReachableVault` and `StoreEvent` reads from `./types` instead of the app's `shared/vault`; `src/types.ts` declares them structurally (no runtime code);
`indexedDbKv(factory, name, schema)`: `name` was `name = "social-cache"` and is now a required `string` with no default. Nothing else changed in the function.

the `Persist` constructor no longer uses parameter properties (`private readonly kv`, `readonly principal`): both are declared as fields and assigned in the body, so the source compiles under `erasableSyntaxOnly`; behaviour and the public API are the same, and `tsconfig.json` sets `erasableSyntaxOnly` so `npm run typecheck` fails if one comes back.

library.title: Device copy of what an app read
library.note: The copy kept in the browser per person and workspace, as a starting point and never an answer, bounded to 25 MB. For the copy in memory only take session-cache; for the hook that shows it take use-cached.
